I have never put chemical fertilizer on my beans because they grow well enough without it, and I need to save my cash for the millet plot. I will spread two wheelbarrows of cow dung from my compound since this land is mine and I want to keep the soil soft and fertile. I will plant the brown seeds I kept from last season because they still germinate, and my family and I can do all the work on this small plot ourselves — about twenty days from planting to harvest.
